data.text: TRAFFIC ADVISORY (North Knox) - KUB crews will implement a temporary closure of both westbound and the inside eastbound lane on a short section of Merchant Drive between Scenicwood Road and Davida Road from 8:30 a.m. – 4 p.m. on Wednesday, January 28, as work is performed on the wastewater collection system. The curbside eastbound lane will be used to alternate traffic flow in both directions. Alternate routes include Scenicwood Road, Davida Road, and Schubert Road. Traffic control measures, including flaggers, channeling devices, and signage will be in place to assist with maintaining traffic flow. Access to businesses will be maintained.

TRAFFIC ADVISORY: Gander RCMP advises of slowed travel along the Trans-Canada Highway due to a tractor trailer jackknifed on the bridge in Appleton. Emergency crews are responding to the scene.

Although the Trans-Canada Highway remains passable at this time, motorists are urging others to drive with extra caution as the bridge deck is extremely slippery.

Please approach this area with caution and reduce your speed. 

Updates will be provided when information is available.

#nltraffic
